records.name: Mistral Vibe
records.license: Apache-2.0 root; Rust TUI crate declares Proprietary
records.one_liner: Coding-agent product whose default Unified Harness separates a deterministic Rust state machine from Python effect execution with write-ahead recovery; legacy Python loop remains selectable.

dims.loop: Default Rust step/apply/checkpoint state machine driven by Python runtime; legacy AgentLoop remains behind --legacy-harness. Effects and observations are explicit protocol objects.
dims.providers: Mistral-first model services with OpenAI Chat/Responses, Anthropic and Vertex protocol adapters; connectors, registry and some product services remain vendor-coupled.
dims.tools: Filesystem/process and custom Python tools, MCP client, plus run_typescript code mode. Executor types determine recovery policy and sandbox reach.
dims.context: Project/user instructions, skills, configurable context budget, result clipping and compaction; unified versus legacy behavior must be distinguished.
dims.state: Write-ahead input, action intent and result journal plus checkpoints and replay. Recovery policies reconnect-or-fail, reconcile, idempotent-retry or fail by effect kind; no universal exactly-once external effects.
dims.safety: Trust-gated project configuration, permissions and approval policy; optional caller-provided sandbox adapter covers selected tools, while other host operations remain outside it.
dims.extensibility: Agent-plugin manifests, hooks, skills, custom tools and MCP; internal middleware is a closed set, not a configurable plugin middleware pipeline.
dims.multi_agent: Unified named asynchronous child sessions with message/wait/interrupt/close; default limits eight children, four concurrent turns, depth one. Session worktrees, not per-child isolation.
dims.surfaces: Python/Rust TUIs, headless exports, app-server protocol and ACP IDE integration; unpublished/internal harness APIs are importable but lack a stable independent SDK promise.
dims.observability: Optional OTel GenAI tracing and unified effect/recovery metrics, usage limits and exports; default OTel endpoint is Mistral unless configured otherwise.

builds_on: Rust local-harness state machine and Python effect runtime
Mistral and other provider protocol adapters
used_by: First-party Vibe CLI/TUI and ACP integrations
key_insights: The Unified Harness is the default at this pin; a stale ADR must not override the actual runtime selector.
Durability comes from recorded protocol inputs/effects and explicit recovery policies, not merely transcript persistence.
Root Apache licensing and the Rust TUI Proprietary manifest conflict should be resolved before reusing that crate.

features_notes.in_process_sdk: Importable internal/unpublished APIs; no stable separately published harness SDK established.
features_notes.os_sandbox: External host-supplied adapter; no built-in default confinement.
features_notes.plan_mode: Legacy profile exists; hidden from the unified mode picker at this pin.
features_notes.http_server: The app-server protocol is not evidence of a generic HTTP agent server.

checked_claims: Write-ahead action/result ordering and effect-specific recovery
limitations: Static inspection only, no recovery or isolation tests.
Inherited detailed chapter received targeted claim review and all citation-path/range validation.
Runtime, TUI and product versions denote separate boundaries.
